blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When you have a problem with your files, you talk to the help desk. The IT team is small, but it is very responsive. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow.

Today you learn five useful words: folder, document, copy, backup and version. You can use them when you organize your files or when you join an online meeting. Go slowly — one step at a time.

Good IT habits protect the whole company. The team restarts the backup every evening, just in case. When something looks strange, call IT support. You can do it!

items.q: Where does IT support work?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words: folder, document, copy, backup and version."

items.q: When does the team restart the backup?
items.why: "The team restarts the backup every evening, just in case."

items.q: The text says "just in case." This suggests that the team…
options: wants to be ready if something goes wrong
items.why: Inferência: "just in case" = por precaução, para estar pronto se algo der errado.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: big problems are impossible to stop
you should never call IT support
small good habits help a lot
items.why: Inferência: "Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow" — pequenos hábitos ajudam muito.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James ajudando um usuário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, this is James from IT support. I can help you with your files today.

First, look at the shared drive. There is a folder for your team. Open it, please. Inside, you can see some documents. Good.

Now, I want you to make a copy of the report. Never work on the only file. Always keep a copy, just in case. This is a good habit.

The backup runs every evening, so your work is safe at night. But during the day, the copy is your friend.

One more thing. Look at the name of the file. There is a version number at the end. Always use the new version, not the old one. The new version is on the shared drive.

That's all for now. It is easy, right? Call me again if something looks strange. You can do it! Have a nice day.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "Hi, this is James from IT support."

items.q: What does James ask the user to make?
items.why: "I want you to make a copy of the report."

items.q: When does the backup run?
items.why: "The backup runs every evening, so your work is safe at night."

items.q: Why does James say "the copy is your friend"?
options: Because copies are fun to make
Because a copy keeps your work safe during the day
Because the copy is a real person
items.why: Inferência: a cópia protege o trabalho durante o dia, então é sua "amiga".

items.q: How would you describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele explica com calma, incentiva e diz "You can do it!".

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The folder is working well today." A folder is…
items.why: Folder = pasta, onde você guarda os arquivos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a new ___ on the help desk board."
items.why: Document = documento; é o que aparece no quadro do help desk.

items.q: "The copy is ready for you to check." A copy is…
items.why: Copy = cópia de um arquivo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We restart the ___ every evening, just in case."
items.why: Backup = cópia de segurança; é reiniciado toda noite.

items.q: "The version is on the shared drive." A version is…
items.why: Version = versão do arquivo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de IT. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please back up your files before you go home." To back up means to…
options: make a safe copy of the files
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança.

items.q: "Can you log in to the shared drive?" To log in means to…
options: enter with your name and password
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com usuário e senha.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the new version." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new folder to every office." To roll out means to…
options: put it in use, step by step
items.why: Roll out = colocar em uso aos poucos, em cada lugar.

items.q: "If something looks strange, please reach out to IT." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato, procurar ajuda.
